compiled_state.title: Write failing integration tests for GitHub PR DefenseStore and mirror workflow
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: Write integration tests covering GitHubPRDefenseStore behavior (fork-PR fallback, payload-size handling, soft-fallback to TrackerDefenseStore) and the mirror-defenses-to-pr workflow step (idempotency, ordering vs llm-review)
**Why**: TDD discipline for the External-API portion of this epic per the preplanning TDD requirement. Tests must exist and fail before implementation (S12, S13) starts so behavior is driven by observable assertions.
**Scope**:
  IN:
  - Integration tests for GitHubPRDefenseStore.write() detecting head_repo != base_repo and downgrading to no-op + log
  - Integration tests for mirror-defenses-to-pr workflow step idempotency (2 invocations produce 1 set of comments)
  - Integration tests for GitHubPRDefenseStore.load() soft-fallback when mirror has not run
  - Integration tests for defense_text payload-size cap (4096 chars) and arbiter ruling summary truncation
  - RED confirmation: tests run and fail before S12/S13 begins; failing run summary recorded as ticket comment
  OUT:
  - Implementation of GitHubPRDefenseStore (S12)
  - Mirror workflow step (S13)
  - Migration of inline REVIEW-DEFENSE comments (S14)

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, integration tests for the GitHub PR DefenseStore + mirror exist and have been observed failing on a clean checkout
  ← Satisfies: "Migration via best-effort file-path binding, fixture-based validation, and forward telemetry"
- Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Considerations

- [Testing] Tests must use mocked GitHub API client to avoid live API calls during CI
- [Testing] RED state recorded via .claude/scripts/dso ticket comment <story-id> 'RED confirmed: <test output summary>'

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
